title: OZONOXY 100
pageDescription: Industrial ozone generator OZONOXY 100, Standart series. Output 100 g/h. Total disinfection up to 1500 m³.
shortDesc: Industrial ozone generator, Standart series, with 100 g/h output. Total disinfection up to 1500 m³; medium contamination — up to 3500 m³.
description: The industrial ozone generator OZONOXY 100, Standart series, is a high-capacity system for disinfecting large industrial facilities. Treated room volume: 1500-3500 m3. Total disinfection up to 1500 m³, medium-level treatment up to 3500 m³.
features: No nitrogen oxide generation during ozone production
Nominal output can be increased by up to +20% by supplying fresh air to the generator via a flexible duct
Oxygen feed via quick-connect fitting for up to 50% higher output
Stainless-steel enclosure used in medicine and the food industry
Fine filtration — prevents electrode degradation from dust and grease buildup
Multimodal operation — distribute ozone flows across rooms or zones at different times, power levels, and exposure
tasks: disinfection, pest control, rodent control, deodorization, detoxification
ctaText: Contact us for consultation and to place an order.
